services.value: Provides Environmental Health & Safety services (e.g., asbestos, mold, lead, indoor air quality/odor assessments, fire & smoke damage assessments/testing, disaster/emergency services, illicit drug testing & decontamination, and occupational safety training). Also offers due diligence & remediation management (e.g., Phase I & II ESAs, PFAS due diligence, environmental assessments, hazardous materials surveys, property condition assessment, groundwater testing, soil testing & delineation, radon testing, remediation design & management, and UST/AST decommissioning & compliance) plus energy consulting, construction services, and lab services (fully accredited environmental laboratory with analytical testing).
